title: Primary Dealers - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

source.name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

summary: The New York Fed maintains a list of 24 primary dealers—trading counterparties that implement monetary policy, make markets for official accountholders, and bid on a pro-rata basis in Treasury auctions. Most recent addition: MUFG Securities Americas Inc. (January 15, 2026).
key_points: Primary dealers are the designated trading counterparties of the New York Fed for monetary policy implementation
Primary dealers are required to make markets for the New York Fed on behalf of its official accountholders
Primary dealers must bid on a pro-rata basis in all Treasury auctions at reasonably competitive prices
Current list contains 24 primary dealers as of early 2026
MUFG Securities Americas Inc. added January 15, 2026
SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc. added January 31, 2025
Credit Suisse AG, New York Branch removed June 30, 2023 (previously Credit Suisse Securities (USA) LLC was removed and replaced in 2017)
why_it_matters: Primary dealers are foundational market infrastructure for the Federal Reserve's monetary policy operations, Treasury market liquidity, and government securities distribution. Understanding who these counterparties are is essential for assessing potential fragilities in market plumbing, particularly during stress events when dealer capacity and behavior become critical.
macro_context: The primary dealer community represents the core mechanism through which the Federal Reserve transmits monetary policy into financial markets. Historical changes (Lehman 2008, MF Global 2011, Credit Suisse 2023) illustrate market structure vulnerabilities and institutional evolution.
market_structure_context: This page documents the official list of primary dealers—the institutional framework underlying the Fed's open market operations and Treasury market functioning. Each addition or removal signals changes to the counterparty network that executes Fed policy and provides Treasury market liquidity.
important_numbers: MUFG Securities Americas Inc. added January 15, 2026
SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc. added January 31, 2025
